F1: Lines 122-123 use `groupResource.getId()`, which is the authz resource's UUID, not the group ID (the group ID is stored as the resource name, as V1 does with `getName()`), so the set fed to the user search and count filters holds the wrong IDs.
F2: canManage()` accepts a VIEW scope, so an admin with only an all-groups VIEW grant passes `requireManage()` in `addTopLevelGroup` and can create groups; the javadoc describing this does not make a VIEW grant allowing writes correct.
F3: V2's no-argument `canView()` calls `hasPermission(null, …)`, which only checks the all-groups resource, so a caller with VIEW on a single group cannot reach `/groups/count`, and an all-groups VIEW holder may see every group anyway.
